# Mechanics of Sport

> > Physics-based online instruction for skiing and snowboarding, teaching techniques through the lens of mechanics and biomechanics.

Mechanics of Sport provides structured ski and snowboard lessons that explain how and why techniques work using principles of physics, mechanics, and biomechanics. The site aims to deepen understanding of winter sports through scientific analysis of movement, equipment, and technique.
